runtimeRule: Only records with status approved may resolve state paths into runtime image sources. Approved paths must be individual production derivatives from matching transparent masters and must not point into source-safe-keeping, review-only, QA, contact-sheet, or rejected folders.
batteryPrecedent: Battery Buddy V3 remains the only approved production character set.

empty.requiredVisual: sleepy or resting, low energy, child-safe and not distressed
empty.approvalGate: must be newly authored from approved reference; chart/contact-sheet crop is forbidden

low.requiredVisual: gently tired or waking, visually distinct from empty
low.approvalGate: must be rebuilt or reauthored as a true 2048px transparent master before approval

calm.approvalGate: must be rebuilt or reauthored as a true 2048px transparent master before approval

happy.requiredVisual: active, friendly smile, clear positive posture
happy.approvalGate: must be rebuilt or reauthored as a true 2048px transparent master before approval

excited.requiredVisual: energetic, celebratory, bright but not visually chaotic
excited.approvalGate: must be rebuilt or reauthored as a true 2048px transparent master before approval

identityRequirements: same Leon face, hair, body proportions and outfit language across all five states
visible uppercase LEON name on clothing or a natural badge
one character only, transparent background, no labels, no percentage text, no poster contamination
runtime path remains hidden until every state passes visual and technical QA
blockers: current generated production candidates are below Battery Buddy V3 visual quality
supplied individual references are 1254px review sources, below 2048px production master requirement
Leon empty state must be rebuilt from approved poster/reference material, not chart-cropped into runtime
nextProductionSteps: author or generate true individual 2048px transparent masters for all five states
preserve visible uppercase name on clothing or a natural badge
bind every accepted master to source hashes and visual QA evidence
only then expose approved runtime web derivatives through data/character-assets.json
